tools.name: pirsch_list_domains
tools.description: List the Pirsch dashboards (domains) the OAuth client can read: id, hostname, display name, time zone and role. Use the id as domain_id in every other tool. A dashboard-level client sees one domain; an account-level client sees all. GET /api/v1/domain.

tools.name: pirsch_get_domain
tools.description: One Pirsch dashboard (domain) by id, with its time zone, hostname, role and subscription state. GET /api/v1/domain?id=.

tools.name: pirsch_get_overview
tools.description: Quick overview of a dashboard: visitors, views, growth compared with the previous period, a visitors time series and the number of team members. Cached by Pirsch; takes no date range or filters. GET /api/v1/statistics/overview.

tools.name: pirsch_get_totals
tools.description: Totals for a period: visitors, views, sessions, bounces, bounce rate and conversion rate. Not grouped by day, so returning visitors are counted once. GET /api/v1/statistics/total. Text filters (hostname, path, entry_path, exit_path, event, language, country, city, referrer, referrer_name, channel, o

tools.name: pirsch_get_visitors_time_series
tools.description: Visitors, views, sessions, bounces and bounce rate per day, week, month or year (see scale). Use it for traffic charts and trends. GET /api/v1/statistics/visitor. Text filters (hostname, path, entry_path, exit_path, event, language, country, city, referrer, referrer_name, channel, os, browser, scree

tools.name: pirsch_get_growth
tools.description: Growth of visitors, views, sessions, bounces, time spent and conversion rate compared with the previous period of the same length. GET /api/v1/statistics/growth. Text filters (hostname, path, entry_path, exit_path, event, language, country, city, referrer, referrer_name, channel, os, browser, screen

tools.name: pirsch_get_active_visitors
tools.description: Visitors on the site right now (or in the past n seconds), with the pages they are on and their countries. GET /api/v1/statistics/active.

tools.name: pirsch_get_time_distribution
tools.description: Visitors by hour of the day, by minute (only when from and to are the same day), or by weekday and hour (Monday is 0). Shows when traffic peaks. GET /api/v1/statistics/hours, /minutes or /weekdays. Text filters (hostname, path, entry_path, exit_path, event, language, country, city, referrer, referre

tools.name: pirsch_get_duration
tools.description: Average session duration over time, or average time on page over time, in seconds. GET /api/v1/statistics/duration/session or /duration/page. Text filters (hostname, path, entry_path, exit_path, event, language, country, city, referrer, referrer_name, channel, os, browser, screen_class and utm_*): p

tools.name: pirsch_list_pages
tools.description: Top pages with visitors, views, sessions, bounces, bounce rate and average time on page. type=entry lists landing pages, type=exit lists exit pages. Filters narrow the data (for example country=de, path=~blog). Results are rows with visitors, views, sessions, bounces and relative shares. GET /api/v1

tools.name: pirsch_list_hostnames
tools.description: Traffic per hostname. Mostly useful for rollup views that combine several hostnames. GET /api/v1/statistics/hostname. Text filters (hostname, path, entry_path, exit_path, event, language, country, city, referrer, referrer_name, channel, os, browser, screen_class and utm_*): prefixes !, ~ and ^ mean

tools.name: pirsch_list_referrers
tools.description: Where visitors come from: referrers (by=referrer) or traffic channels such as Organic Search and Paid Search (by=channel). Filters narrow the data (for example country=de, path=~blog). Results are rows with visitors, views, sessions, bounces and relative shares. GET /api/v1/statistics/referrer or /c

tools.name: pirsch_list_utm
tools.description: Visitors per UTM source, medium, campaign, content or term. Filters narrow the data (for example country=de, path=~blog). Results are rows with visitors, views, sessions, bounces and relative shares. GET /api/v1/statistics/utm/{dimension}. Text filters (hostname, path, entry_path, exit_path, event,

tools.name: pirsch_list_geography
tools.description: Visitors per country, region, city or language. Filters narrow the data (for example country=de, path=~blog). Results are rows with visitors, views, sessions, bounces and relative shares. GET /api/v1/statistics/country, /region, /city or /language. Text filters (hostname, path, entry_path, exit_path

tools.name: pirsch_list_devices
tools.description: Visitors per browser, browser version, operating system or screen class (XXL to S). Filters narrow the data (for example country=de, path=~blog). Results are rows with visitors, views, sessions, bounces and relative shares. GET /api/v1/statistics/browser, /browser/version, /os or /screen. Text filte

tools.name: pirsch_get_platforms
tools.description: Visitors on desktop, mobile and unknown platforms, as counts and shares. GET /api/v1/statistics/platform. Text filters (hostname, path, entry_path, exit_path, event, language, country, city, referrer, referrer_name, channel, os, browser, screen_class and utm_*): prefixes !, ~ and ^ mean is not, cont

tools.name: pirsch_list_events
tools.description: Custom events with count, visitors, views, conversion rate, average duration and their metadata keys. Use pirsch_get_event_breakdown for the values of one metadata key. GET /api/v1/statistics/events. Text filters (hostname, path, entry_path, exit_path, event, language, country, city, referrer, refer

tools.name: pirsch_get_event_breakdown
tools.description: The values of one metadata key of one event, with count, visitors and conversion rate. Both event and event_meta_key are required. GET /api/v1/statistics/event/meta.

tools.name: pirsch_list_event_pages
tools.description: The pages on which an event was triggered, with visitors and views. The event name is required. GET /api/v1/statistics/event/page.

tools.name: pirsch_list_goals
tools.description: Conversion goals with their definition (page pattern, event, targets) and the visitors, views and conversion rate for the period. GET /api/v1/statistics/goals. Text filters (hostname, path, entry_path, exit_path, event, language, country, city, referrer, referrer_name, channel, os, browser, screen_c

tools.name: pirsch_list_funnels
tools.description: The funnels defined for a dashboard, with their steps and step filters. Use a funnel id in pirsch_get_funnel. GET /api/v1/funnel.

tools.name: pirsch_get_funnel
tools.description: Visitors per funnel step for a period: visitors, share of the first step, drop-off between steps. The filter applies to the first step. GET /api/v1/statistics/funnel. Text filters (hostname, path, entry_path, exit_path, event, language, country, city, referrer, referrer_name, channel, os, browser, s

tools.name: pirsch_list_tags
tools.description: Tag keys with views and share. Use pirsch_get_tag_breakdown to see the values of one key. GET /api/v1/statistics/tags. Text filters (hostname, path, entry_path, exit_path, event, language, country, city, referrer, referrer_name, channel, os, browser, screen_class and utm_*): prefixes !, ~ and ^ mean

tools.name: pirsch_get_tag_breakdown
tools.description: The values of one tag key with views and share. The tag filter (the key) is required. GET /api/v1/statistics/tag/details.

tools.name: pirsch_list_sessions
tools.description: Individual visitor sessions: start, duration, entry and exit page, page views, bounce, country, city, referrer, browser, OS and UTM data. visitor_id is a string (a 64-bit number). Use pirsch_get_session for one session's page views and events. GET /api/v1/statistics/session/list. Text filters (hostn

tools.name: pirsch_get_session
tools.description: All page views and events of one session in time order. Both ids come from pirsch_list_sessions. GET /api/v1/statistics/session/details.

tools.name: pirsch_list_filter_values
tools.description: The values that exist for a filter in a period, such as all page paths, referrers, countries, browsers or event names. Use it to find valid values before filtering. GET /api/v1/statistics/options/{dimension}.
